name: case-study-builder
title_zh: 客户一句好评，它替你扩写成能进提案的案例页
tagline_zh: 别让成交只留在聊天记录里。把零散成果整理成结构化的案例，提案、销售对话、官网背书都能直接复用，客户自己看了都想转发。
tagline_en: Stop leaving wins in chat logs. Turn scattered results into structured case studies you can drop into proposals.
desc_en: Turn client wins into formatted case studies for proposals, social proof, and sales conversations. Use when someone needs to document results, build credibility, or create reusable proof assets.
why_zh: 它不写空话，按提案和社交证明的真实结构组织素材，产出的是能直接进销售流程的资产，不是一篇没人看的总结。
why_en: No fluff—it structures raw wins into assets that fit real proposal and social-proof formats, so you get usable ammunition, not.
limit_zh: 只处理你喂进去的文字素材，不会自己挖数据或访谈客户。产出是草稿级案例页，排版和品牌视觉仍需你手动完成。
limit_en: Only works from text you feed it—no data mining or client interviews. Output is a draft case study; layout and branding are on you.
title_en: Turn one client win into a proposal-ready case study
